SELECT DISTINCT admin_permission.id , admin_permission.`name` , admin_permission.description, admin_permission.url FROM admin_role JOIN admin_role_permission ON admin_role.id = admin_role_permission.rid JOIN admin_permission ON admin_role_permission.pid = admin_permission.id WHERE admin_role.id=#{id}
ORDER BY admin_permission.id

SELECT DISTINCT admin_menu.id, admin_menu.path, admin_menu.`name`, admin_menu.name_zh, admin_menu.icon_cls, admin_menu.component, admin_menu.parent_id, admin_role_menu.rid FROM admin_role JOIN admin_role_menu ON admin_role.id = admin_role_menu.rid JOIN admin_menu ON admin_role_menu.mid = admin_menu.id WHERE admin_role.id=#{id} and admin_menu.parent_id = 0 ORDER BY admin_menu.id
